note: Owner 2026-11-18 (ADR-002, RULES_REVIEW section 14): what reaches orders - which trade opens, how big, when it closes. Its fingerprint (release_id) is taken by every Jarvis pass and written on every ledger record. During a measurement period these change only for a bug fix or a stricter risk limit; any change is reported and splits the period's measurements before/after. Research, reports, Jarvis and the Control Center are not in the list and change freely.
not_listed_note: Code review 2026-11-20: tests/test_release_guard.py fails when a listed .py imports a local module that is neither listed nor here with the reason it cannot change which trade opens, how big or when it closes.
